messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout ROLL-2026-157 -> v2 API. Change window 2026-03-27 02:00 UTC. Plan: canary 10% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Release notes: https://redwood.in/release/157. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency >1s for 2 consecutive windows. Tagging @Maria @Aj for pinlist & header checks.

Maria: On it — compiling pinlist (mobile SDKs + tenants with custom headers). ETA ~15m.

Aj: FYI we saw a streaming schema edge-case in staging when header `X-Api-Version` is omitted; gateway drops `api-version` case sometimes. Recommend gateway casefold normalization or pin mobile clients that don't send header.

Kevin: Suggest initial pinlist: mobile-sdk <=2.3.1, tenant `acme-inc`, tenant regex `^beta-`. Also propose reduce initial canary to 10% for 10m and require a 5m stable window before ramp.

Liz: Prober alert in eu-west-1 — streaming probe sometimes returns 422. Investigating. Recommend hold until 3 consecutive probes pass.

deploy-bot: Hold placed by operator @Liz. Canary not started.

Maria: I'll remove `acme-inc` from the initial target and update the pinlist live. Also going to add a note in the release docs about the header normalization workaround.

Sam: Please make the release notes explicit about migration steps. Ops needs a quick rollback command snippet to include.

Kevin: Rollback CLI: `deploybot rollback ROLL-2026-157 --immediate`. Operator handoff note: the person who initiates the shift should be on-call for the next 2 hours.

Liz: Probe fixed in eu-west-1 — passed 3 checks at 02:12 UTC. Recommending start at 02:20 UTC but keep initial throttle conservative.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to start 02:20 UTC at 10% for 10m, then 25% for 10m. Operator: @Liz.

Aj: Notifying mobile SDK owners now. I'll push a canary-only gateway patch that casefolds header names behind a flag so only canary traffic uses it.

Maria: Release notes updated with migration snippet, pin instructions, and the gate flag link: https://redwood.in/pr/roll-157.

Liz: Monitoring: I'll watch p95 and 5xx by tenant. If any tenant sees >0.5% 5xx for a 5m window I will trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started 02:20 UTC at 10% — metrics: canary_ok=true, 5xx=0.08%, p95=420ms. Posting again at next ramp.

Kevin: Thanks. If the canary holds we proceed with staged ramp. Documenting decision and pinlist in the release ticket.

Maria: Pinlist snapshot posted to the release ticket. Will follow up with a short email to affected customers in morning PST. :email:

Aj: Hotfix + canary flag PR created. Will merge once metrics look stable.

Liz: I'll keep eyes on EU and US regions for the next 45m and will call rollback if thresholds breach.

Sam: I'll update the external notes + changelog after full ramp completes.

deploy-bot: Closing thread for now — will post final outcome in this thread.
